title: 1:1 notes
audience: For managers and the people they meet with every week or two.
description: A running 1:1 note. Topics go in during the week, your AI writes up the meeting and keeps the follow-ups in Pinto Notes.
tagline: Topics, follow-ups and a record of every 1:1.
seoTitle: 1:1 meeting notes template for ChatGPT and Claude
note:
1:1 notes

One running note for your 1:1s with one person. Add topics during the week so nothing waits until you've forgotten it.

## Next time

## Follow-ups

## Past 1:1s

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "1:1 notes". During the week, when I mention something to bring up, add it under "Next time" as a bullet with append_to_note. After the 1:1, I'll tell you how it went. Add a section at the start of "Past 1:1s" with append_to_note (at_start): a "###" heading with the date, what we talked about, and how they seemed. Add anything either of us promised under "Follow-ups" as a checklist line, then remove the topics we covered from "Next time" with edit_note.

asks: For my next 1:1: ask how the on-call week went.
We just had our 1:1. She wants to lead the next launch and asked for a mentor.
What did I promise last time?

args.text:
- How the on-call week went
- Feedback on the design review

### 30 September
- On-call was rough: two pages at night. She wants a quieter rotation.
- Wants to lead the November launch.
- Seemed tired but positive.

- [ ] Me: find her a mentor from the platform team
- [ ] Her: draft the launch plan by 14 October
